proof_body:
by
  intro F G f g S K hF hG hf hg
  refine Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  have hC : 0 < |K| + 1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C, C = |K| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hCdef] at hC
  have hη : 0 < min 1 (ε / (2 * C + 1)) := lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨η, hηdef⟩ : ∃ η, η = min 1 (ε / (2 * C + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hηdef] at hη
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := hηdef ▸ min_le_left _ _
  have hη2 : (2 * C + 1) * η ≤ ε := by
    have h1 : η ≤ ε / (2 * C + 1) := hηdef ▸ min_le_right _ _
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h1
    linarith
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hF η hη, Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hG η hη] with n hn1 hn2 x hx
  have a1 := hn1 x hx
  have a2 := hn2 x hx
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at a1 a2
  have hfx : |f x| ≤ C := by
    rw [hCdef]
    linarith [hf x hx, le_abs_self K]
  have hgx : |g x| ≤ |K| := (hg x hx).trans (le_abs_self K)
  have hGx : |G n x| ≤ C := by
    have h1 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (G n x) (g x)
    rw [hCdef]
    linarith
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  have e : f x * g x - F n x * G n x = -((F n x - f x) * G n x + f x * (G n x - g x)) := by ring
  rw [e, abs_neg]
  have b1 : |(F n x - f x) * G n x| ≤ η * C := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul a1.le hGx (abs_nonneg _) hη.le
  have b2 : |f x * (G n x - g x)| ≤ C * η := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hfx a2.le (abs_nonneg _) hC.le
  have b3 := abs_add_le ((F n x - f x) * G n x) (f x * (G n x - g x))
  nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (F G : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (K : ℝ), TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S → TendstoUniformlyOn G g Filter.atTop S → (∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ K) → (∀ x ∈ S, |g x| ≤ K) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => F n x * G n x) (fun x => f x * g x) Filter.atTop S
